item.title: qmk keyboard
item.author: murat@muwat.org (murat)
item.description: I didn’t know my keyboard (Glorious GMMK 2 96% ISO) supports QMK firmware. I didn’t even hear about QMK while buying this keyboard back then. A couple days ago, while mindlessly scrolling YT videos, I saw a video about home row mods. I’ve heard about that in the past and always thought this thing is doable by only using custom open motherboards and self-built microcontroller keyboards. I’m too dumb so I didn’t realize my keyboard is a prebuilt custom keyboard. So turns out my keyboard supports QMK. I began exploring QMK. I had a couple issues with QMK Linux dependencies (Arch Linux Python pip env related problems) and fixed them by just installing packages with sudo.
